question: Who is referred to as the 'Father of Genetics'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gregor Johann Mendel**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gregor Mendel is known as the Father of Genetics. **
 
• **Gregor Mendel, through his work on pea plants, discovered the fundamental laws of inheritance.**
 
• He laid the foundation of mathematics in genetic science, known as Mendelism.
 
• Mendel used a number of contrasting visible characters of garden peas.
 
• Which includes round/wrinkled seeds, tall/short plants, white/violet flowers, etc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Results of Mendel's Experiments: 

 
 
• ​Traits are inherited to future generations through genes, which remain unchanged.
 
• For each trait, an individual inherits one factor from each parent.
 
• Some traits may remain dormant, but can still be passed on to the next generation.
